body:
Confirmed via systemd unit inspection + process cmdline: dw-server.service's --match-log has pointed at /home/fatbaby/DEADWEIGHT/var/matches (this repo's own git working tree) since deploy. This session's own standing repo-hygiene habit -- 'git checkout -- var/matches/matches.ndjson && rm -f var/matches/decks.ndjson' before every commit, believing it was disposable local test-run output -- was actually truncating/deleting the LIVE production match/deck log every time it ran today. matches.ndjson's entire git history is one stale commit from 2026-09-18 (no later snapshot exists to recover from); decks.ndjson was never git-tracked at all (no backup anywhere on this box -- checked). The true historical ~40k-match total and the founder's saved decks are NOT recoverable. Fix: moved the live log directory to ~/.local/var/deadweight/matches (outside any repo), updated dw.env's DW_MATCH_LOG_DIR and restarted dw-server.service, updated IDUNA's DEADWEIGHT_DECK_LOG env var and restarted iduna.service, live-verified WOTAN's /api/v1/games/deadweight/decks endpoint now serves from the new path with growing, continuous data. Removed the stale in-repo copies from git tracking, left var/matches/README.md as an explicit warning against ever pointing match-log config back at a repo path. Told the founder directly this was caused by my own dev/test hygiene commands, not the old client. DEADWEIGHT commit d0f1a4a.

⚓ ☃
title: Root cause of WOTAN deck-stats/player-deck data loss: found and fixed (S518)
